quotes.author: Sarah Handrahan
quotes.text: Sarah Handrahan2 years agoOur Captain Larry was an absolute gem! He gave us the perfect combination of fun facts, good conversation and making us feel well cared for. The day was such a great experience and memory for me and my son and the entire process was easy from start to finish with Jon. Would absolutely recommend using them and the 30' mini yacht was a great vessel to tour the area, swim at the sandbar and grab a bite. Definitely book 4 hours, it was worth it!

quotes.author: Lisa Booth
quotes.text: Lisa Booth2 years agoWhat a fantastic experience! The communication was outstanding. Captain Larry was friendly, knowledgeable, funny ,experienced and very responsive to our requests. We had eight people for a bachelorette trip to the sandbar and had a great time! I highly recommend Boat Party Fort Lauderdale. Thank you again!

quotes.author: Kelly Campbell
quotes.text: Kelly Campbell3 years agoWe had an absolute blast on this adventure with Captain Chase! He took us to all of the best bars and the sand bar, while also sharing fun local facts. Captain Chase was incredibly fun and patient with our lively group of girls. We highly recommend this experience and would love to come back!

quotes.author: Nicholas Mastrogiorgio
quotes.text: Nicholas Mastrogiorgio3 years agoGreat time on our tour of the intercoastal and trip to the sand bar. Carlos the captain was great, he was informative and was great with the kids.I would definitely recommend this company for a nice relaxing day on the water if you're ever in the area.

quotes.author: Kim Srey
quotes.text: Kim Srey3 years agoGreat time for all!!! The crew was fun and there was plenty of seating and cooler space. One of the highlights of our trip! Luke and Adam were great helping us on/off boat, getting us drinks while we were in the water and taking pics. Would def recommend!

quotes.author: John Raggio
quotes.text: John Raggio2 years agoReally fun experience. We took our two young sons age 6 and 8 on a 2-hour ride starting at 5pm. We brought sandwiches and snacks and enjoyed the sunset while cruising around. Chase was knowledgeable about the area and a great host.
